structured_output.what_is_happening: 币安中秋 ("Binance Mid-Autumn") is a Chinese-language meme token. It was launched straight onto a PumpSwap pool around 07:09 UTC. GMGN shows migrated_unix=0, meaning it never went through a pump.fun bonding curve. It rode the Mid-Autumn Festival theme (Sept 25, 2026) and Binance's Mid-Autumn giveaway campaign. In its first 15 minutes it showed about 944 unique buyers against 53 sellers and roughly $175k volume on a ~$30k market cap. By T2 it was already fading: DexScreener shows -17% over 5 minutes and market cap down to about $26k from a ~$39k ATH. The creator still holds about 16% of supply and the LP is 100% unlocked. At least 10 earlier tokens with the same name exist, and all show zero liquidity.

narrative.description: A Binance Mid-Autumn Festival holiday meme. The festival day has now passed, and Binance's only visible tie-in is a small giveaway campaign.
narrative.why_spreading: A seasonal holiday plus the Binance brand, popular with Chinese degen traders. The festival day is over and I found no specific news catalyst.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is simply the latest of many copies that currently has volume. There is nothing that makes it canonical.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 same-name tokens, created 1-25 hours earlier. All have zero liquidity and appear dead or rugged.

authenticity.evidence: The buyer/seller asymmetry looks unnatural: about 944 unique buyers vs 53 sellers in 15 minutes, which fits a bot-driven buy flow. GMGN reports no smart or KOL wallets and no paid promotion. It lists 2 bundler wallets and a 16.6% fresh-wallet rate, and flags the creator's 16% holding as a rat-trader position. I found no X or social posts.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X data. Small buyers on Chinese-language Telegram could be real.

structural_risks: The LP is 100% unlocked on a direct PumpSwap pool, so the creator can remove liquidity
The creator holds about 16% of supply
A pattern of repeatedly launching same-name tokens, all of which went to zero liquidity
Momentum was already reversing at T2 (-17% over 5 minutes)

structured_output.counterargument: Chinese Binance-themed memes can get sudden community pushes. Over 1,000 holders in 12 minutes is real breadth, and a $26k market cap needs only modest new buying to double.
unknowns: Whether the creator is linked to the deployers of the earlier same-name tokens
Whether the buyer flow is bots

source_coverage.notes: The contract search returned nothing relevant. News turned up only a generic Binance Mid-Autumn giveaway. The token has no socials or site in the packet. Time was short.

structured_output.thesis: A late holiday meme with many dead same-name copies, an unlocked LP, the creator holding 16%, and momentum already rolling over at entry. Low chance of reaching 2x, high rug risk.
